about.title: ବିଷୟରେ
about.contextFirstParagraph: ଏହି ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପଟି ଏକ ମଜାଦାର ଏବଂ ଅନନ୍ୟ ପୋର୍ଟଫୋଲିଓ ସৃষ্টি କରିବାର ଇଚ୍ଛାରୁ ଜନ୍ମ ହୋଇଛି।
about.contextSecondParagraph: ଭାବନାଟି ହେଉଛି Windows XP କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟର ଇଣ୍ଟରଫେସ୍ ସୃଷ୍ଟ କରାଯିବ, ଯାହା ଦରଶକଙ୍କୁ ମୋ କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟରର ସେସନ୍‍ର ଫୋଲ୍ଡର୍ ଏବଂ ଫାଇଲ୍ ଆଦି ବ୍ରାଉଜ୍ କରିବାକୁ ଅନୁମତି ଦେବ।
about.contextThirdParagraph: ମୁଁ ମୋ ଉଦ୍ୟମଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଏକ ଭିନ୍ନ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିକୋଣରୁ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରିବାକୁ ଚାହାଁଥିଲି, ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ଉପଯୋଗକର୍ତ୍ତାମାନେ ଘୁରିପାରିବେ। ବେସିକ ଭାବରେ ଏକ ଡିଜିଟାଲ୍ ବିଜ୍ନେସ୍ କାର୍ଡ୍ ଅତିକ୍ରମ ହୋଇଥାଏ। ଏକ ଇଣ୍ଟରାକ୍ଟିଭ୍ ସୃଷ୍ଟି।
about.contextFourthParagraph: ଏହି ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପଟିକୁ ଏକ ସଚ୍ଛି Windows XP କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟର ଇଣ୍ଟରଫେସ୍ ପରି ଯଥାସମ୍ଭବ ନିକଟରେ ଡିଜାଇନ୍ କରାଯାଇଛି, ଏହାରେ ଏକ ଡେସ୍କଟପ୍, ଫୋଲ୍ଡର୍ ଏବଂ ଫାଇଲ୍ ଥାଏ।
about.contextFifthParagraph: Windows XP ମୋତେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଓଏସ୍ ଥିଲା ଏବଂ ତାହାର ଡିଜାଇନ୍ ମୋ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ମେଡେଲିନ୍ ଡି ପ୍ରସ୍ଟ୍ ଅଟୁନ୍ତି। ମୁଁ ଏହାକୁ ସ୍ମରଣ କରିବାକୁ ଚାହାଁଥିଲି।
about.contextSixthParagraph: ଏହି ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପଟି Vue.js, Vuex, Vue Router, ଏବଂ SCSS ଦ୍ୱାରା ସୃଷ୍ଟି ହୋଇଛି। ଏହାକୁ ପ୍ରାୟ ଏକ ବର୍ଷ ଲାଗିଛି (ବିରତି ସହିତ)।
about.contextSeventhParagraph: ଏହି ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପଟି ବହୁତ ଆଗ୍ରହ ଏବଂ ଧୈର୍ୟ ସହିତ ତିଆରି ହୋଇଛି, ଆଶା କରେ ଆପଣ ମୋର କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟର ଦେଖିବାକୁ ଭଲ ପାଇବେ!
about.helpFirst: ଏହି ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପ Dockurr windows xp ଦ୍ୱାରା ସହଯୋଗରେ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା, ଯାହା ମୋତେ ମୋର କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟରରେ ଏକ Windows XP ପରିବେଶ ପ୍ରଚଳିତ କରିବାକୁ ଅନୁମତି ଦେଇଥିଲା।
about.helpSecond: Spotify API ମୋତେ ମୋର ପ୍ଲେଲିଷ୍ଟ ସୂଚନାଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଆଣିଯିବାକୁ, ସାଇଟ୍‌ରେ ଦେଖାଇବାକୁ ଏବଂ ଏକ ସଂଯୁକ୍ତ ପ୍ଲେୟର୍ ଯୋଡିବାକୁ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିଛି।
about.helpThird: ସର୍ଭର ପାଇଁ, ମୁଁ ସାଇଟ୍ କମ୍ପାଇଲ୍ କରିବା ଏବଂ ଯୋଗାଯୋଗ ଫର୍ମ୍‌କୁ ପରିଚାଳନା କରିବା ପାଇଁ Node.js ସର୍ଭର ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିଥିଲି। ସାଇଟ୍ Hostinger ଉପରେ ହୋଷ୍ଟ୍ ହୋଇଅଛି ଏବଂ CI / CD ମୋର homeserver ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ କରାଯାଇଛି।
about.helpFourth: Internet Archive ସାଇଟ୍ ମୋତେ Windows XP ଇମେଜଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପୁନରୁଦ୍ଧାର କରି ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପରେ ସାମିଲ କରିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିଛି। ତାଙ୍କୁ ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ।
about.helpFifth: ମୋର ବିଲେଇ ଆଂଶିକ ଭାବରେ କୀବୋର୍ଡ୍ ଉପରେ ଚାଲିଥିଲା ଭାବରୁ ସହଯୋଗ କଲେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ସେ ମୋତେ ନୀତିଗତ ସମର୍ଥନ ଦେଇଥିଲା।

logma.contextFirstParagraph: Logma production is a movie production company based in Rennes. Founded by Baptiste Fablet. At the start of this project, there was already a logma production site created by the company director with Wordpress.
logma.contextSecondParagraph: The decision was made to rebuild this site from scratch, with a simple, tried-and-tested technical stack, to try and make a website without a Framework and without someoneonce helping to make it fast and efficient.
logma.contextThirdParagraph: In order to make the entrepreneur autonomous in the management of this site, it was necessary to develop a back-office from which he could publish new photos, add projects and links to his videos.
logma.goalFirst: Redesign of website with existing graphic identity
logma.goalThird: Develop a back-office to manage the site
logma.goalFifth: Improve loading speed and overall performance

pangaia.contextFirstParagraph: Pangaia is an open-source application designed to raise awareness of plants.
pangaia.contextSecondParagraph: The aim was to create a fun and practical interface for managing your garden.
pangaia.contextThirdParagraph: But also to discover new plants using gamification.
pangaia.contextFourthParagraph: Provide information on the flora around us, depending on the user's location.
pangaia.goalFirst: Try out the application in demo mode
pangaia.goalFourth: Add a plant to your garden
pangaia.goalFifth: Connect to the weather in real time
pangaia.goalSixth: Reminders for tasks to be carried out on your plant or in your garden
pangaia.tasksDoneFirst: Help with database design and modeling
pangaia.tasksDoneThird: Work on UX with usability tests
pangaia.tasksDoneFifth: Creation of a page listing plants and categories
pangaia.tasksDoneSixth: Setting up an API and documentation with Swagger
pangaia.CDMText: Partial conceptual modeling of the database, concerning changes to be made to the project.

clench.contextFirstParagraph: An exercise as part of a CSS Framework & Layout course at MyDigitalSchool Rennes.
clench.contextSecondParagraph: The aim was to create the graphic interface of a web application in a week. No backend, but all graphic design.
clench.contextThirdParagraph: A campus-themed website, to create a fictitious medium on which the student union could communicate.
clench.contextFourthParagraph: With the help of Baptiste Marie, also a student, we created the graphic identity and build the website.
clench.goalFirst: Design a website and a wireframe based on customer's specifications
clench.goalThird: Develop the front end of the application using a CSS Framework

emc2.contextFirstParagraph: As part of my work-study program at Screenup, I developed the agenda page and the event page template for the EMC2 performance hall in St Grégoire.
emc2.contextSecondParagraph: I used the ACF plugin in WordPress to add custom fields, allowing the venue team to easily add content for the creation of events.
emc2.contextThirdParagraph: The project was based on a mockup created by Screenup’s web designer, aligning with the client’s visual identity and needs.
emc2.contextFourthParagraph: Production updates were tested in staging and deployed via SSH using Visual Studio Code.
emc2.goalFirst: Create an intuitive interface to view upcoming events.
emc2.goalSecond: Enable easy event management through the WordPress back office.
emc2.goalThird: Apply a design consistent with the EMC2 visual identity.
emc2.goalFourth: Test in staging to ensure site stability.
emc2.goalFifth: Deploy updates to production via SSH.
emc2.goalSixth: Optimize navigation for a better user experience.

aidella.contextFirstParagraph: Les Terres d'Aidella is a dog breeding kennel located in the Vosges region. Passionate animal lovers with the goal of sharing their passion and expertise with as many people as possible.
aidella.contextSecondParagraph: The problem was that their web presence was very limited, and they had no platform to showcase their activities online apart from their Facebook page.
aidella.contextThirdParagraph: So we addressed this with Nathan Fournil in charge of content creation and writing, and myself responsible for the design, website development, and deployment.
aidella.goalSecond: Increase visibility by working on SEO
aidella.goalThird: Develop a back office for content management
aidella.goalFourth: Create an intuitive and visually appealing interface for visitors
aidella.goalFifth: Allow visitors to discover the different dog breeds
aidella.goalSixth: Present the kennel and its activities
aidella.tasksDoneFirst: Design and modeling of the relational database
aidella.tasksDoneFirstDetails: We had to consider the client’s needs and present a robust and scalable model.
aidella.tasksDoneSecondDetails: Laravel was chosen for its MVC pattern and MySQL database, providing a solid stack for building and improving the project in the future. Additionally, using Orchid for the back office made content management easier.
aidella.tasksDoneThird: The front-end was developed with Vue.js
aidella.tasksDoneThirdDetails: Each page is a Blade template, based on a page model that contains all metadata tags, avoiding the need to use Vue for SEO management.
aidella.tasksDoneFourthDetails: Orchid allows for easy content management. It is possible to create pages, articles, categories, images, users, etc., all through an intuitive and user-friendly interface.
aidella.tasksDoneFifth: Deployment pipeline to a third-party web server
aidella.tasksDoneFifthDetails: Thanks to the Homeserver project, the project can be precompiled with Jenkins and the artifact sent to the production server. A change to the `main` branch of the Git repository is enough for the site to be automatically updated. The database is also updated with migrations using the `make deploy` command from the Makefile.
aidella.tasksDoneFifthDetailsSecond: This method saves significant time and avoids needing npm or any JS package manager on the production server.

fanny-portfolio.contextFirstParagraph: Fanny Séraudie is a freelance illustrator based in Limoges. She wanted an online portfolio to showcase her work through a minimalist and aesthetic interface.
fanny-portfolio.contextSecondParagraph: The site was designed with Laravel Orchid for the back office and Vue.js for the front end, allowing Fanny to easily manage her projects and illustrations.
fanny-portfolio.contextThirdParagraph: The solution offers autonomous content management, SEO optimization, and a modern user experience that reflects Fanny's visual identity.
fanny-portfolio.goalFirst: Create an adaptive image display system for different formats
fanny-portfolio.goalSecond: Develop a responsive mosaic with varying image sizes
fanny-portfolio.goalThird: Optimize display in portrait and landscape modes
fanny-portfolio.goalFourth: Implement a zoom feature on illustrations for better visualization
fanny-portfolio.goalFifth: Ensure smooth navigation between different projects
fanny-portfolio.goalSixth: Maintain visual quality across all devices and resolutions

homeserver.contextFirstParagraph: This project was carried out by Pierre, who owns a video production company, and me, a web developer.
homeserver.contextSecondParagraph: A team you wouldn't necessarily count on to set up a server, I agree. But we share a common passion. Digging into subjects we know nothing about and trying to understand how a server works and how to set it up.
homeserver.goalFirst: Make a storage server that can also deploy applications
homeserver.goalSecond: Being able to access the server from anywhere
homeserver.goalThird: It is possible to edit a video project on remote
homeserver.goalFourth: Install automation services such as Jenkins, Sonarqube, etc.
homeserver.goalFifth: Have online website monitoring and alerts in case of loss of services
homeserver.goalSixth: Host pre-production sites before putting them online
homeserver.goalSeventh: Redundancy in data and remote access to it
homeserver.goalNinth: Be less expensive than a pre-assembled equivalent with the same performance
